subject_session: Achilles_10252013 (prototype) plus Buddy_06272013, Cicero_09012014, Cicero_09172014, Gatsby_08022013; 4 rats, 5 linear-track sessions

headline_stat.name: Fraction of CA1 pyramidal cells qualifying as place cells in at least one direction

stated_limitation: The other three used a closed circular maze, where a lap wraps around and the two-direction traversal logic used throughout does not apply; they were excluded on maze geometry before any spiking data were examined. ... Two data-quality caveats are worth restating. The `SpatialSeries.rate` field in this dandiset holds the sampling period rather than the frequency, and one unit in each of three sessions contains two concatenated spike trains. Both are handled explicitly above; neither is detectable without checking, and either would corrupt the analysis silently.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsaki hc-11) dorsal CA1 linear-track recordings are the canonical choice for place cells, and the three circular-maze sessions were excluded on geometry before any spiking data were examined.
justification.handling: Data were streamed from S3 with remfile/h5py, the corrupted NWB time base was rebuilt and asserted against the MazeEpoch duration, units with backwards-jumping spike times were detected on the raw ragged array and dropped, and pyramidal selection used the cell_type label plus explicit rate bounds and a 5 cm/s speed mask.
justification.analysis: Occupancy-normalised rate maps with a per-unit circular-shift null that preserves spike-train temporal structure, split-half reliability, cross-validated Bayesian decoding against a rolled-tuning-curve null, and an independent held-out Poisson GLM together exceed what the claim requires, though the per-unit shuffle p is uncorrected across ~540 tests and omits the conventional +1.
justification.correctness: Every reported number reproduces exactly from the committed CSVs and the field properties (32 cm width, 6.0 Hz peak, 0.61 bits/spike) are textbook, but the headline 78% spatially selective exceeds the preregistered 0.30-0.75 ceiling, which caps this axis at 1; the exceedance is marginal and arises from the either-direction denominator, since the per-direction rate of 329/540 = 0.61 is in range.
justification.figures: Nine figures show the phenomenon unambiguously with units, sample sizes, per-unit nulls, population summaries and a cross-session panel, and example cells were selected among qualifying place cells spanning the track rather than by maximum effect; the only defect is an overprinted colorbar label in fig04 and one broad example (unit 202).
justification.honesty: Nothing is misrepresented and all quantitative claims trace to the committed output, but the write-up does not flag that a 78% yield is high relative to typical reports or that it depends on the either-direction criterion, and it describes an r = 0.26 GLM/Skaggs correlation as the two measures agreeing.
justification.verdict: The core work is sound, reproducible and better controlled than most published single-session analyses; I would ask for the per-direction fraction, a multiple-comparison correction, and a sentence reconciling the yield with the literature before taking the 78% figure at face value.
